name: @wf-agent/openapi-codegen
description: On-demand TypeScript codegen from the committed wf-server OpenAPI snapshot

scripts.gen:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.statSync('../../crates/app/wf-server/openapi.json').mtimeMs;const b=fs.statSync('../../apps/web-app/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts').mtimeMs;if(b<a){console.error('schema.d.ts is older than openapi.json; run npm run gen');process.exit(1)}else{console.log('schema.d.ts is fresh')}"
